# S-02 pre-work — AMM 2.12.5 source-read (no game)

Read 2026-10-12. Game was not launched. Files were not written under the game directory.

Source: `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Cyberpunk 2077\bin\x64\plugins\cyber_engine_tweaks\mods\AppearanceMenuMod\`
`init.lua` sets `AMM.currentVersion = "2.12.5"`.
Modules: `Modules/tools.lua`, `Modules/util.lua`, `Modules/anims.lua`, plus `init.lua` (personality table, hotkey callers) and `Localization/en_US.lua` (look-at labels).

Database queried: that folder's `db.sqlite3` (18,800,640 bytes). This is the DB AMM opens. `D:\night-city-live\catalog\amm_universe.sqlite` is present and was not the query target. Row counts on `db.sqlite3` match F-012: workspots 43765, photomode_poses 142, entities 4363, appearances 30069, locations 121.

## How another mod reaches these

`init.lua` assigns `AMM.Tools`, `AMM.Poses`, and `AMM.Spawn`. It does `Util = require('Modules/util.lua')` (comment: "Load Util Module Globally") and does not set `AMM.Util`. S-01 already observed `AMM.Util` is nil from CypherAgent. `tools.lua` keeps its own `local Util = require('Modules/util.lua')`, so `AMM.Tools` methods that call `Util` still work when invoked from outside.

## Functions

| Claimed name | Real? | Owner | Signature | Next call |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FreezeNPC | yes | `Tools` | `Tools:FreezeNPC(handle, freeze)` | freeze: `WorkspotSystem:StopInDevice` if `Poses.activeAnims` has this entity, then `TimeDilationHelper.SetIndividualTimeDilation(handle, CName.new("radialMenu"), 0.0)`. unfreeze: `UnsetIndividualTimeDilation`, then `PlayInDeviceSimple` + `SendJumpToAnimEnt` if an active anim was stored |
| ActivateFacialExpression | yes | `Tools` | `Tools:ActivateFacialExpression(target, face)` | `target.handle` needs `ReactionManager` and `AnimationControllerComponent`. `ResetFacial(0)`, then after 0.5 s `ApplyFeature(CName.new("FacialReaction"), AnimFeature_FacialReaction)` with `face.category` and `face.idle` |
| ActivateLookAt | yes | `Tools` | `Tools:ActivateLookAt()` | no arguments. Reads `Tools.currentTarget`, `Tools.lookAtTarget`, `Tools.selectedLookAt`, stiffness fields. Calls `Util:NPCLookAt(handle, lookAtTarget, headSettings, chestSettings)` |
| ToggleInvisibility | yes, player only | `Tools` | `Tools:ToggleInvisibility()` | `Game.GetPlayer():SetInvisible(Tools.playerVisibility)` then `UpdateVisibility()` and flips `Tools.playerVisibility`. Not an NPC toggle. `Tools:ToggleInvisibleBody` also walks the player meshes only |
| SetGodMode | yes | `Util` | `Util:SetGodMode(entity, immortal)` | `Game.GetGodModeSystem():ClearGodMode(entityID, CName.new("Default"))`, then `AddGodMode` with `gameGodModeType.Immortal` or `Mortal`. `Tools:ToggleGodMode` is a different player-stat toggle (`Util:ModStatPlayer`) |
| EquipGivenWeapon | yes | `Util` | `Util:EquipGivenWeapon(targetPuppet, weapon, override)` | `AIEquipCommand` on `AttachmentSlots.WeaponRight`, `itemId = weapon`, `failIfItemNotFound = false`, `durationOverride = 1`, `SendCommand`. `override` is unused. Callers in `tools.lua` and the give-weapon hotkey then call `Util:EquipPrimaryWeaponCommand` (`AISwitchToPrimaryWeaponCommand`, `unEquip = false`). `weapon` is `GetItemID().tdbid` from `Util:GetPlayerWeapon()` |
| PlayAnimationOnTarget | yes | `Poses` (`anims.lua`) | `Poses:PlayAnimationOnTarget(t, anim, instant, caller)` | stops any active workspot, spawns `anim.ent` at the target (yaw + 180), then `WorkspotSystem:PlayInDeviceSimple(anim.handle, t.handle, false, anim.comp, CName.new('AMM_WORKSPOT'), nil, 0, 1, nil)` and `SendJumpToAnimEnt(t.handle, anim.name, instant)`. `t` needs `.handle` and `.hash`. `anim` needs `.ent`, `.name`, `.comp` (`.rig` only for the player-self retarget). A nil `caller` stores the anim in `Poses.activeAnims[t.hash]`, which freeze/unfreeze replays |
| SetWeather | no | — | — | closest: `Tools.weatherSystem = Game.GetWeatherSystem()` in `Tools:new`. `Tools:DrawTimeActions` calls `Tools.weatherSystem:SetWeather(weather.cname, 10.0, 5)` or `ResetWeather(true)` when `cname == "reset"`, and only if `AMM.CodewareVersion >= 4`. The time-slider branch passes the option table instead of `cname`; the combo branch passes `cname` |
| SetTime | yes | `Tools` | `Tools:SetTime(time)` | `time` is minutes from midnight (`hour * 60 + minute`, slider 0–1440). `Game.GetTimeSystem():SetGameTimeByHMS(hour, minute, 0)` |
| TriggerCombatAgainst | yes | `Util` | `Util:TriggerCombatAgainst(handle, target)` | both arguments are puppet handles. Mutual `SetAttitudeTowards(..., AIA_Hostile)`, `SetReactionPreset(ReactionPresets.Ganger_Aggressive)` on `handle`, `handle:TriggerCombat(target)`, and `target:TriggerCombat` against the player and against `handle` |

`Util:NPCLookAt(handle, target, headSettings, chestSettings)` (called by `ActivateLookAt`): `ReactionManager:DeactiveLookAt()`, then a `LookAtAddEvent` queued on `handle`. Target is `target.handle` or the player if `target` is nil. Head part is added unless the mode is "Eyes Only"; chest part only when the mode is "All". English labels in `en_US.lua` are `All`, `Head Only`, `Eyes Only`, and `ActivateLookAt` compares against those literal strings. Defaults in `Tools:new`: `headStiffness = 0.0`, and `ResetLookAt` sets head suppress `1.0`, chest weight `0.1`, chest suppress `0.5`. `selectedLookAt` is set to `lookAtOptions[1]` (All) during init.

`Tools:SetNPCAttitude(entity, attitude, target, group)` is the friendly/neutral path. `entity` is an AMM target (`entity.handle`). `target` defaults to the player. `group` defaults to that target's attitude group. Next calls: `SetAttitudeGroup` and `SetAttitudeTowards`. This is not `TriggerCombatAgainst`.

`AMM:GetPersonalityOptions()` in `init.lua` supplies `face` tables `{name, idle, category}`. OG rows used by `ActivateFacialExpression`: Neutral 2/2, Joy 5/3, Smile 6/3, Sad 3/3, Surprise 8/3, Aggressive 2/3, Anger 1/3, Interested 3/1, Disinterested 6/1, Disappointed 4/3, Disgust 7/3, Exertion 1/1, Nervous 10/3, Fear 11/3, Terrified 9/3, Pain 2/1, Sleepy 5/1, Unconscious 4/1, Dead 1/2 (idle/category).

Weather `cname` strings in `Tools.weatherOptions`: `reset`, `24h_weather_rain`, `q302_light_rain`, `24h_weather_cloudy`, `24h_weather_fog`, `24h_weather_heavy_clouds`, `24h_weather_light_clouds`, `24h_weather_pollution`, `24h_weather_sandstorm`, `24h_weather_sunny`, `24h_weather_toxic_rain`, `q302_deep_blue`, `q302_squat_morning`, `q306_epilogue_cloudy_morning`, `q306_rainy_night`, `sa_courier_clouds`.

## Pose SQL

`workspots` columns: `anim_id`, `anim_name`, `anim_rig`, `anim_comp`, `anim_ent`, `anim_fav`, `anim_cat`.
Every workspot row uses `anim_ent = base\amm_workspots\entity\workspot_anim.ent`.
`anim_comp` is `amm_workspot_base` (39236) or `amm_workspot_custom_base` (4529). `anim_cat` is NULL on all 43765 rows (no collab poses in this DB).

`photomode_poses` columns: `pose_name`, `ignore`. 142 rows. Keyword hits there: crouch 2, hand 5, talk 1, lean 5, sit 1. No aim, typing, kneel, dead, or bar.

Queries (Python sqlite3), then the rows kept as candidates:

```sql
SELECT anim_name, anim_rig, anim_comp
FROM workspots
WHERE anim_name = ?
ORDER BY anim_rig;

SELECT pose_name FROM photomode_poses
WHERE pose_name LIKE '%aim%' OR pose_name LIKE '%crouch%'
   OR pose_name LIKE '%hand%' OR pose_name LIKE '%talk%'
   OR pose_name LIKE '%lean%' OR pose_name LIKE '%sit%';
```

Broader `LIKE` counts on `workspots.anim_name` (not candidate lists): aim 607, crouch 215, kneel 813, dead 159, gesture 287, surrender/hands_up 10. No generic name contains both crouch and aim except the one-off transition `weyland__crouch__2h_gun__01__to__stand__2h_gun_aim__01__turn0__01`.

Candidates (all `anim_comp = amm_workspot_base`, same `anim_ent` as above). Rigs are the rows that exist for that name.

| Role | anim_name | rigs | also in photomode_poses |
|---|---|---|---|
| aim | `aim_loop` | Big, Man Average, Woman Average | no |
| aim | `stand__rh_gun_aim__01` | Man Average, Player Man, Woman Average | no |
| aim | `tpp_aim_loop` | Player Man, Player Woman | no |
| aim | `action__handgun` | Man Average, Woman Average | yes |
| crouch-aim | `action___crouch_and_shoot` | Man Average, Woman Average | yes |
| crouch (no aim) | `action_crouch` | Man Average, Woman Average | yes |
| typing | `sit_chair_table_keyboard__2h_on_keyboard__01` | Big, Man Average, Player Man, Player Woman, Woman Average | no |
| typing | `sit_chair_table_lean0__2h_on_keyboard__01__typing__01` | Big, Man Average, Woman Average | no |
| hands-up | `stand_cheer__2h_up__01__gesture_handsup__01` | Man Average, Woman Average | no |
| hands-up | `stand__2h_hands_up__01` | Woman Average only | no |

# S-02 — Puppetry

**Hypothesis.** We can hold six spawned actors (four party, two enemies, at least one gang record via F-005) at authored
nodes in authored poses for 10+ minutes, and change pose on command, without game AI moving them.

**Pre-work (no game).** Done 2026-10-12. Source-read AMM 2.12.5 (`Modules/anims.lua`, `tools.lua`, `util.lua`, plus the callers in `init.lua`). Evidence: [2026-10-12-s02-amm-source.md](../../raw/evidence/2026-10-12-s02-amm-source.md). Facts: F-013, F-025, F-026. The in-game procedure below has not run.

**Procedure.** Spawn and teleport stay on F-004 / F-008. Puppetry calls, from the source-read:

1. Spawn 6 actors (F-004 path, `try_direct_record` for the gang record). Measure command → visible latency.
2. Teleport each to a node with yaw (F-008 `Game.GetTeleportationFacility():Teleport`). Repeat 20×; note snaps, falls, or floating.
3. Pose, then freeze. `t` is an AMM target with `.handle` and `.hash`. `anim` is `{name, ent, comp, rig}` from a `workspots` row (`ent` is always `base\amm_workspots\entity\workspot_anim.ent`, `comp` is `amm_workspot_base` for the candidates below).
   - `AMM.Poses:PlayAnimationOnTarget(t, anim, true)`
   - `AMM.Tools:FreezeNPC(t.handle, true)` then `AMM.Tools:FreezeNPC(t.handle, false)`
   - Pass no `caller`, so the anim stays in `Poses.activeAnims` and unfreeze replays it.
4. Expression, look-at, weapon.
   - `AMM.Tools:ActivateFacialExpression(t, face)` with `face` from `AMM:GetPersonalityOptions()` (`category` + `idle`; see evidence). Needs `ReactionManager` and `AnimationControllerComponent` on `t.handle`.
   - Look-at: set `AMM.Tools.currentTarget = t`, `AMM.Tools.lookAtTarget` to another target or nil (nil looks at V), `AMM.Tools.selectedLookAt = AMM.Tools.lookAtOptions[1]` (name `"All"`), then `AMM.Tools:ActivateLookAt()`. That calls `Util:NPCLookAt`.
   - Weapon: `Util:GetPlayerWeapon()`, then `Util:EquipGivenWeapon(t.handle, weapon:GetItemID().tdbid, nil)`, then `Util:EquipPrimaryWeaponCommand(t.handle)`. `Util` is not `AMM.Util` (nil). Confirm the bare `Util` global is visible from CypherAgent before this step; `pcall` it.

Do not call `Util:TriggerCombatAgainst` on this set; it forces `AIA_Hostile` and `TriggerCombat`. Confirm no wandering, fleeing, combat, or reactions to each other or to V; confirm passers-by and NCPD ignore the set.
6. Leave it running for 10 minutes and watch for drift, T-poses, despawns.

`AMM.Tools:ToggleInvisibility()` only calls `Game.GetPlayer():SetInvisible`. Do not use it on actors.

Weather and time are not part of this procedure. If a later beat needs them: `AMM.Tools:SetTime(minutes)` and `AMM.Tools.weatherSystem:SetWeather(cname, 10.0, 5)` (F-025). There is no `SetWeather` on Tools or Util.

Nine of the ten F-013 names are real functions in AMM 2.12.5. `SetWeather` is not. S-02 stays `planned`. The in-game procedure has not run.

## Real vs missing

| Claimed name | Result | Call |
|---|---|---|
| FreezeNPC | real | `Tools:FreezeNPC(handle, freeze)` in `tools.lua` → time dilation, plus workspot stop/replay |
| ActivateFacialExpression | real | `Tools:ActivateFacialExpression(target, face)` in `tools.lua` → `ResetFacial`, then `ApplyFeature("FacialReaction")` |
| ActivateLookAt | real | `Tools:ActivateLookAt()` in `tools.lua` (no args; uses Tools UI state) → `Util:NPCLookAt` |
| ToggleInvisibility | real, player only | `Tools:ToggleInvisibility()` in `tools.lua` → `Game.GetPlayer():SetInvisible` |
| SetGodMode | real | `Util:SetGodMode(entity, immortal)` in `util.lua` → `GodModeSystem` Clear + Add. `Tools:ToggleGodMode` is a different player-stat toggle |
| EquipGivenWeapon | real | `Util:EquipGivenWeapon(puppet, tdbid, override)` in `util.lua` → `AIEquipCommand` on `AttachmentSlots.WeaponRight`. `override` is unused. Callers then `EquipPrimaryWeaponCommand` |
| PlayAnimationOnTarget | real | `Poses:PlayAnimationOnTarget(t, anim, instant, caller)` in `anims.lua` → spawn `anim.ent`, `PlayInDeviceSimple`, `SendJumpToAnimEnt` |
| SetTime | real | `Tools:SetTime(minutes)` in `tools.lua` → `SetGameTimeByHMS` |
| TriggerCombatAgainst | real | `Util:TriggerCombatAgainst(handle, target)` in `util.lua` → mutual hostile + `TriggerCombat` |
| SetWeather | missing | Closest: `Tools.weatherSystem:SetWeather(cname, 10.0, 5)` inside `Tools:DrawTimeActions`, where `weatherSystem` is `Game.GetWeatherSystem()`. `reset` calls `ResetWeather(true)` |

`AMM.Tools` and `AMM.Poses` are on the AMM table. `Util` is a bare global from `init.lua`, not `AMM.Util` (already nil from CypherAgent in S-01). The friendly path is `Tools:SetNPCAttitude`, not `TriggerCombatAgainst`.
